title: About Labrity
intro: Labrity is a web studio based in Münster, Germany. The owner is Andreas Tonn. We build more than websites: custom web applications, SaaS platforms, CRM systems and iOS apps.

sections.title: Where we work
sections.text: Labrity is based in Münster and works with businesses across North Rhine-Westphalia and throughout Germany. Consultation and implementation take place conveniently online.

sections.title: Our approach
sections.text: Every website is created around the business, audience and positioning — without generic templates. Structure, design, trust, SEO and the user journey are developed as one connected system.

sections.title: Technology and languages
sections.text: We work with modern technologies such as Next.js, React and Node.js. Our website is available in German, English, Russian and Ukrainian. Consultation and delivery happen online.

capabilities.title: What we build
capabilities.intro: From a clear company website to custom software: we plan, design and develop everything in one place.

items.title: Websites and landing pages
items.text: Professional websites, landing pages and portfolio sites for freelancers and businesses: fast, mobile-friendly and built for search engines.

items.title: Web applications and SaaS
items.text: Custom web applications and SaaS platforms with user accounts, roles, dashboards and a database, from the first idea to a running product.

items.title: Custom CRM development
items.text: A CRM that fits your workflow: customers, inquiries, tasks and quotes in one place, instead of standard software full of features you do not need.

items.title: iOS app development
items.text: Native iOS apps for iPhone, from concept and design to implementation. We also build our own apps and know the path from prototype to finished product.

items.title: Online shops and platforms
items.text: Online shops, booking and marketplace platforms and customer portals that match your business model.

items.title: Relaunch and further development
items.text: Modernize existing websites and systems, make them faster and develop them cleanly, without putting existing rankings at risk.
